therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Gemcitabine plus high-dose chemotherapy (vinorelbine, carmustine, etoposide, cyclophosphamide)
therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: DNA synthesis and cell cycle progression
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: DNA synthesis inhibition by gemcitabine combined with alkylating and topoisomerase inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced tumor cell killing through multi-agent cytotoxic therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Hodgkin's lymphoma patients undergoing autologous stem cell transplant
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Dose-limiting toxicity of gemcitabine due to non-hematologic toxicity

results.effect_size: 3/146 patients experienced dose-limiting toxicity at 1500 mg/m2, 0/146 at 1250 mg/m2
results.dose_information: Gemcitabine 1250 mg/m2 or 1500 mg/m2 with high-dose chemotherapy followed by autologous stem cell rescue
